title.en: Swap USDC and USDT on Uniswap v4's StablePair pool
title.zh-TW: 在 Uniswap v4 的 StablePair 池子兌換 USDC 和 USDT

summary.en: One Universal Router execute sells exactly the card's amount of one stablecoin for at least the card's minimum of the other in the USDC/USDT StablePair pool, paid to the Safe. It needs a Permit2 allowance to the router first (uniswap/allow-router), and refuses any other pool, route, recipient or a deadline over 30 minutes.
summary.zh-TW: 一次 Universal Router 的 execute，在 USDC/USDT 的 StablePair 池子賣出卡片上剛好的數量，換回至少卡片最低數量的另一種穩定幣，付給 Safe。事先需要給 router 的 Permit2 授權（uniswap/allow-router）；其他池子、其他路線、其他收款人或超過 30 分鐘的截止時間都會被拒絕。

text.en: A plain stablecoin swap; the pool's fee hook can be upgraded by Uniswap governance, and the app's other routes get MISMATCH.
text.zh-TW: 單純的穩定幣兌換；池子的手續費 hook 可由 Uniswap 治理升級，app 走其他路線時會得到 MISMATCH。

pastTxsConclusion.en: Large swaps were split across several pools (v3 and v4, or DAI): another route, so MISMATCH. No Safe's trace sells USDT; one EOA's does.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 大額兌換會拆到好幾個池子（v3 加 v4，或經 DAI）：那是別的路線，所以會 MISMATCH。沒有 Safe 賣 USDT 的 trace，只有一個 EOA 的。

text.en: SETTLE: the router asks Permit2 to move the sold amount from the Safe to the PoolManager
text.zh-TW: SETTLE：router 請 Permit2 把賣出數量從 Safe 轉給 PoolManager

text.en: Permit2 moves the sold token from the Safe into the PoolManager
text.zh-TW: Permit2 把賣出的代幣從 Safe 轉進 PoolManager

text.en: The swap in the StablePair pool, whose hook sets the fee
text.zh-TW: 在 StablePair 池子交換，手續費由它的 hook 決定

text.en: TAKE: the PoolManager pays the bought token to the Safe
text.zh-TW: TAKE：PoolManager 把買到的代幣付給 Safe

intro.en: Uniswap v4 keeps every pool in one PoolManager contract; a pool may name a hook contract that runs around each swap, here Uniswap Labs' StablePair fee hook.
intro.zh-TW: Uniswap v4 把所有池子放在同一個 PoolManager 合約裡；池子可以指定一個在每次交換前後執行的 hook 合約，這裡是 Uniswap Labs 的 StablePair 手續費 hook。

text.en: v4-core and v4-periphery list their audit reports in their repositories. Uniswap's StablePair security page says OpenZeppelin reviewed the fee mechanism on 9-13 February 2026 and one high finding was fixed; that review covered the non-upgradeable predecessor, and the upgradeable proxy and role model came after it.
text.zh-TW: v4-core 和 v4-periphery 在各自的程式庫列出稽核報告。Uniswap 的 StablePair 安全頁說 OpenZeppelin 在 2026 年 2 月 9 日到 13 日審查了手續費機制，一個高風險問題已修正；那次審查的是不可升級的前一版，可升級代理和角色模型是之後才加的。

text.en: This template covers one route: one swap in the StablePair pool. For a large amount the app may split it across pools (v3 and v4, or through DAI); verify then says MISMATCH.
text.zh-TW: 這個模板只涵蓋一條路線：在 StablePair 池子做一次交換。金額大時 app 可能拆到幾個池子（v3 加 v4，或經 DAI）；那時 verify 會說 MISMATCH。

recommendation.en: Check the app's route shows one pool; on a MISMATCH for another route, ask for that route's template.
recommendation.zh-TW: 確認 app 的路線只顯示一個池子；別的路線得到 MISMATCH 時，再請人做那條路線的模板。

text.en: The StablePair hook is a proxy the Uniswap Governance Timelock can upgrade; only Uniswap's own site lists it. verify checks its pinned code, so an upgrade makes it fail until the pin is renewed.
text.zh-TW: StablePair hook 是 Uniswap 治理 Timelock 可以升級的代理合約；只有 Uniswap 自己的網站列出它。verify 會檢查它釘住的程式碼，所以升級後在更新釘選前都會失敗。

recommendation.en: Open the StablePair deployments page and compare the hook address yourself.
recommendation.zh-TW: 自己打開 StablePair 部署頁比對 hook 地址。

text.en: Only one Safe's transaction fits (USDC to USDT); the USDT-to-USDC direction is seen only in one EOA's. The pool is so busy the searches reach back only 2 to 9 days.
text.zh-TW: 只有一個 Safe 的交易符合（USDC 換 USDT）；USDT 換 USDC 的方向只在一個 EOA 的交易看到。池子太忙，搜尋只往回 2 到 9 天。

recommendation.en: Treat your first USDT-to-USDC verify as the first Safe test of that direction; read its page in full.
recommendation.zh-TW: 把你第一次 USDT 換 USDC 的 verify 當作這個方向第一次 Safe 測試；完整讀它的頁面。

text.en: No independent price: the registry holds no feed for USDC or USDT yet, so card new asks you to type the minimum to receive and says it has no price to compare it with.
text.zh-TW: 沒有獨立的價格：登記表還沒有 USDC 或 USDT 的價格來源，所以 card new 會請你自己輸入最少收到的數量，並說它沒有價格可以比對。

recommendation.en: Type the app's minimum and check it is close to the amount you sell; ask for the Chainlink feeds to be added.
recommendation.zh-TW: 輸入 app 顯示的最低數量，並確認它和賣出數量相近；可以要求加入 Chainlink 價格來源。

role.en: Uniswap's Permit2: it keeps token allowances for users, and moves tokens by those allowances or by a user's signed Permit2 message
role.zh-TW: Uniswap 的 Permit2：替使用者保管代幣授權，依這些授權或使用者簽的 Permit2 訊息轉代幣

text.en: Uniswap's v4 deployments page lists the address in the Permit2 row under Ethereum
text.zh-TW: Uniswap v4 部署頁在 Ethereum 的 Permit2 列出這個地址

text.en: Uniswap/sdks: PERMIT2_ADDRESS is this address, at the pinned commit and at main's tip
text.zh-TW: Uniswap/sdks：PERMIT2_ADDRESS 是這個地址，釘住的 commit 和 main 最新版都一樣

text.en: Etherscan: contract name Permit2, creator 0xd32ff78579352ca78f416120a9f68b65c410871b (labelled "Uniswap: Permit2 Deployer"), creation transaction 0xf2f1fe96c16ee674bb7fcee166be52465a418927d124f5f1d231b36eae65d377
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：合約名 Permit2，創建者 0xd32ff78579352ca78f416120a9f68b65c410871b（標籤「Uniswap: Permit2 Deployer」），創建交易 0xf2f1fe96c16ee674bb7fcee166be52465a418927d124f5f1d231b36eae65d377

text.en: Permit2 source (AllowanceTransfer): approve writes allowance[msg.sender][token][spender]; _transfer reads the allowance of its caller and reverts once it has expired; an amount of 2^160-1 is not reduced by use
text.zh-TW: Permit2 原始碼（AllowanceTransfer）：approve 寫入 allowance[msg.sender][token][spender]；_transfer 讀呼叫者的授權，過期就 revert；數量 2^160-1 不會因使用而減少

text.en: Permit2 source (SignatureTransfer): a transfer spends the owner's token approval to Permit2 on the owner's signature alone, reading no Permit2 allowance
text.zh-TW: Permit2 原始碼（SignatureTransfer）：有 owner 的簽名就能動用 owner 給 Permit2 的代幣授權，不看 Permit2 裡的授權額度

text.en: Permit2 source (AllowanceTransfer): a message the owner signed can set an allowance through permit; lockdown sets only the named pairs' amount to 0
text.zh-TW: Permit2 原始碼（AllowanceTransfer）：owner 簽的訊息可經 permit 設定授權；lockdown 只把指定的代幣和 spender 的數量設為 0

role.en: Uniswap's Universal Router 2.1.2: it runs swaps from a list of commands, and pulls tokens through Permit2 only from the address that calls it
role.zh-TW: Uniswap 的 Universal Router 2.1.2：照指令清單執行兌換，只從呼叫它的地址透過 Permit2 拉代幣

text.zh-TW: Uniswap v4 部署頁在 Ethereum 的 Universal Router 2.1.2 列出這個地址

text.zh-TW: Uniswap/universal-router 部署地址：UniversalRouterV2_1_2 是這個地址；釘住的 commit 就是 main 最新版

text.zh-TW: Uniswap/sdks：以太坊的 UniversalRouterVersion.V2_1_2 是這個地址（讀 main 最新版）

text.zh-TW: Etherscan：合約名 UniversalRouter，創建者 0x2179a60856e37dfeaaca0ab043b931fe224b27b6（標籤「Uniswap V4: Deployer」），創建交易 0x350510f7398242ffc778c086ae6bbe9cc744c33a04468f1a7978e54164638257

text.en: The Uniswap trading API's spec: a request that pins no version defaults to 2.1.2 on chains where it is deployed; 2.2.0 is only for swaps of a permissioned token
text.zh-TW: Uniswap 交易 API 規格：沒指定版本時，在有部署的鏈上預設 2.1.2；2.2.0 只用於受許可代幣的兌換

text.en: Uniswap/interface code at this commit names no router version except 2.2.0 for a permissioned token; what the live app sends was not checked
text.zh-TW: Uniswap/interface 這個 commit 的程式碼除了受許可代幣的 2.2.0，不指定 router 版本；線上 app 實際送什麼沒有查

text.en: Uniswap's notice: 2.1.2 from 2026-09-21; API requests that pin 2.0 or 2.1.1 get an error from 2026-10-21

Verified source on Sourcify: the Permit2 transfers in Dispatcher take msgSender() as payer, and a batch reverts when a from is not msgSender(); Lock sets that to the caller of execute. A search of contracts/ found no Ownable, onlyOwner, delegatecall or selfdestruct
text.zh-TW: Sourcify 的已驗證原始碼：Dispatcher 裡的 Permit2 轉帳以 msgSender() 當付款人，批次中 from 不是 msgSender() 就 revert；Lock 把它設成呼叫 execute 的地址。在 contracts/ 搜尋沒有 Ownable、onlyOwner、delegatecall 或 selfdestruct

text.en: Same Sourcify source: V2 and V3 swaps set the payer to msgSender() or the router itself; the V3 callback passes that payer on and reverts unless its caller is the pool address it computes
text.zh-TW: 同一份 Sourcify 原始碼：V2、V3 兌換的付款人是 msgSender() 或 router 自己；V3 callback 沿用這個付款人，呼叫者不是它算出的池子就 revert

role.en: Uniswap v4's PoolManager: it holds every v4 pool's tokens; the router settles the sold token into it and it pays the bought token out
role.zh-TW: Uniswap v4 的 PoolManager：保管所有 v4 池子的代幣；router 把賣出的代幣付給它，它再付出買到的代幣

text.en: Uniswap's v4 deployments page lists the address in the PoolManager row under Ethereum
text.zh-TW: Uniswap v4 部署頁在 Ethereum 的 PoolManager 列出這個地址

text.en: Uniswap/sdks sdk-core addresses.ts: v4PoolManagerAddress for mainnet is this address, at the pinned commit (main's tip on 2026-11-26)
text.zh-TW: Uniswap/sdks 的 sdk-core addresses.ts：主網的 v4PoolManagerAddress 是這個地址（釘住的 commit，即 2026-11-26 的 main 最新版）

text.en: Uniswap/contracts deployments/1.md lists it as Pool Manager (a lead; not recorded)
text.zh-TW: Uniswap/contracts 的 deployments/1.md 把它列為 Pool Manager（線索，未登記）

text.en: Etherscan: verified as PoolManager (solc 0.8.26); find-sources could not prove the creation: the listed sender made it by CREATE2, which it does not trace
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：驗證名稱 PoolManager（solc 0.8.26）；find-sources 無法證明創建交易：列出的發送者是用 CREATE2 部署的，工具不追蹤這種情況

role.en: Uniswap Labs' StablePair hook of the USDC/USDT v4 pool: it sets each swap's fee; an upgradeable proxy the Uniswap Governance Timelock controls
role.zh-TW: Uniswap Labs 為 USDC/USDT v4 池子做的 StablePair hook：決定每筆交換的手續費；是可升級的代理合約，由 Uniswap 治理 Timelock 控制

text.en: Uniswap's StablePair deployments page lists the address as StablePairHook (hook) under Ethereum, and pool id 0x2b21c65d9a7dc6926ee330a1c6e5a8037fd81774f3dc066536f800128e39f634 for USDC/USDT
text.zh-TW: Uniswap 的 StablePair 部署頁在 Ethereum 下把這個地址列為 StablePairHook (hook)，USDC/USDT 池子 id 為 0x2b21c65d9a7dc6926ee330a1c6e5a8037fd81774f3dc066536f800128e39f634

text.en: developers.uniswap.org/deployments shows it too; same site, so not a second place
text.zh-TW: developers.uniswap.org/deployments 也列出它；同一個網站，不算第二個地方

text.en: No file of the Uniswap GitHub organization found listing it (Uniswap/contracts deployments at 064a8db9 do not); only one place confirms it
text.zh-TW: 在 Uniswap 的 GitHub 組織裡找不到列出它的檔案（Uniswap/contracts 的 064a8db9 部署檔沒有）；只有一個地方確認它

text.en: Etherscan: ERC1967Proxy to StablePairHook 0x5f216d21b1C81346938EDDc1Df7e0111A0F64000; sender 0xE49ACc3B16c097ec88Dc9352CE4Cd57aB7e35B95 through the public CREATE2 deployer; one Upgraded event; admin role to the Timelock 0x1a9C8182C09F50C8318d769245bEA52c32BE35BC
text.zh-TW: Etherscan：ERC1967Proxy，實作是 StablePairHook 0x5f216d21b1C81346938EDDc1Df7e0111A0F64000；發送者 0xE49ACc3B16c097ec88Dc9352CE4Cd57aB7e35B95 透過公用 CREATE2 部署器；只有一次 Upgraded；管理角色給 Timelock 0x1a9C8182C09F50C8318d769245bEA52c32BE35BC

1.execute.commands.en: Two router commands: 0x10 V4_SWAP runs the v4 actions below, then 0x04 SWEEP sends any of the bought token left in the router to the Safe.
1.execute.commands.zh-TW: 兩個 router 指令：0x10 V4_SWAP 執行下面的 v4 動作，然後 0x04 SWEEP 把 router 裡剩下的買入代幣送給 Safe。

1.execute.inputs.en: One input per command, in the same order: the V4_SWAP actions, then the SWEEP.
1.execute.inputs.zh-TW: 每個指令一個輸入，順序相同：先 V4_SWAP 的動作，再 SWEEP。

1.execute.inputs[0].en: The V4_SWAP input: a list of v4 actions and one parameter block per action, run inside the PoolManager's unlock.
1.execute.inputs[0].zh-TW: V4_SWAP 的輸入：一串 v4 動作，每個動作一段參數，在 PoolManager 的 unlock 裡執行。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.actions.en: 0x0b SETTLE pays the sold token in, 0x06 SWAP_EXACT_IN_SINGLE swaps in one pool, 0x0e TAKE pays the bought token out: the app's order for this pool.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.actions.zh-TW: 0x0b SETTLE 付入賣出的代幣，0x06 SWAP_EXACT_IN_SINGLE 在一個池子交換，0x0e TAKE 付出買到的代幣：這是 app 對這個池子的順序。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params.en: The three parameter blocks, one per action above.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params.zh-TW: 三段參數，對應上面的三個動作。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].en: SETTLE: pays the sold token from the Safe into the PoolManager before the swap.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].zh-TW: SETTLE：交換前把賣出的代幣從 Safe 付進 PoolManager。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SE.en: The token paid in: the card's sell token.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SE.zh-TW: 付入的代幣：卡片上的賣出代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SE.en: How much is paid in: the card's sell amount, the same number the swap sells.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SE.zh-TW: 付入多少：卡片上的賣出數量，和交換賣出的數字相同。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SE.en: true: the router pulls from its caller, the Safe, through Permit2; false would pay from tokens the router already holds.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[0].SE.zh-TW: true：router 透過 Permit2 從呼叫它的 Safe 拉款；false 會改用 router 已持有的代幣付。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].en: SWAP_EXACT_IN_SINGLE: sells an exact amount in one pool and reverts unless at least the minimum comes out.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].zh-TW: SWAP_EXACT_IN_SINGLE：在一個池子賣出確切數量，換出的少於最低數量就 revert。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The swap's parameters: which pool, which direction, how much in and the least out.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 交換的參數：哪個池子、哪個方向、賣多少、最少換多少。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The five values that name one v4 pool; their hash is the pool id 0x2b21c65d9a7dc6926ee330a1c6e5a8037fd81774f3dc066536f800128e39f634.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 決定一個 v4 池子的五個值；它們的 hash 就是池子 id 0x2b21c65d9a7dc6926ee330a1c6e5a8037fd81774f3dc066536f800128e39f634。
池子中地址較小的代幣，USDC。
池子中地址較大的代幣，USDT。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: 0x800000 marks a dynamic fee: the hook sets each swap's fee.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 0x800000 代表動態手續費：每筆交換的手續費由 hook 決定。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: 1, the tick spacing of the StablePair USDC/USDT pool.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 1，StablePair USDC/USDT 池子的 tick 間距。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The StablePair hook; another hook would be another pool.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: StablePair hook；換成別的 hook 就是另一個池子。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The direction: true sells USDC for USDT. A wrong direction cannot pay the Safe less; the swap reverts or the effects fail.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 方向：true 是賣 USDC 換 USDT。方向錯了不會讓 Safe 少收；交換會 revert 或效果檢查不通過。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The exact amount sold: the card's sell amount.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 確切的賣出數量：卡片上的賣出數量。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: The least the swap may return, at or above the card's minimum to receive; the router reverts below it.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 交換最少要換回的數量，不低於卡片上的最少收到數量；低於它 router 就 revert。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: An optional per-pool price floor; the app sends 0. Any value can only make the swap revert.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 可選的單池價格下限；app 送 0。任何值都只會讓交換 revert。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.en: Data for the hook; empty, as the app sends it.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[1].SW.zh-TW: 給 hook 的資料；空的，和 app 送的一樣。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].en: TAKE: pays the bought token out of the PoolManager.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].zh-TW: TAKE：從 PoolManager 付出買到的代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: The token paid out: the card's buy token.
1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.zh-TW: 付出的代幣：卡片上的買入代幣。

1.execute.inputs[0].V4_SWAP.params[2].TA.en: Who receives it: the Safe itself.

1.execute.inputs[1].en: SWEEP: sends the router's whole balance of one token to one address.
1.execute.inputs[1].zh-TW: SWEEP：把 router 某個代幣的全部餘額送到一個地址。

1.execute.inputs[1].SWEEP.amountMin.en: 0: no minimum here; the swap's own minimum is the check.
1.execute.inputs[1].SWEEP.amountMin.zh-TW: 0：這裡不設最低；檢查靠交換本身的最低數量。

1.execute.deadline.en: When the router stops accepting the swap; the app sets it about 30 minutes ahead.
1.execute.deadline.zh-TW: router 停止接受這筆交換的時間；app 大約設在 30 分鐘後。

text.en: Read the StablePair deployments page: it lists 0x0000113dCf4ADd69999Fad8F20F2b63F979bfcC0 as StablePairHook (hook) on Ethereum, and the pool key with this hook hashes to the page's pool id. No second owner's place: Uniswap/contracts' deployment files do not list it.
text.zh-TW: 讀了 StablePair 部署頁：它在 Ethereum 下把 0x0000113dCf4ADd69999Fad8F20F2b63F979bfcC0 列為 StablePairHook (hook)，用這個 hook 的 pool key 算出的 hash 等於頁面上的池子 id。找不到第二個擁有者的地方：Uniswap/contracts 的部署檔沒有列它。

recommendation.en: Open the StablePair deployments page and compare the hook address yourself.
recommendation.zh-TW: 自己打開 StablePair 部署頁比對 hook 地址。
